name: exam_section
description: Optional grouping of question-selection rules within an exam. Ports FR-BB31 (Exam Configuration Model), source table `exam_sections` in BilimBaga's backend/migrations/012_exams.up.sql; product spec is corporate_exam_platform_roadmap.md section 3.1. FIELD-LEVEL NOTES. `title` is :localized_text over ["kk","ru","en"] with search_strategy "plain", required false because the source column is a nullable TEXT -- the localization is the same deliberate trilingual upgrade exam.title makes, while the nullability is transcribed from the source. `exam_id` is :string and carries the foreign key to `exam`; the source's UNIQUE (exam_id, sort_order) is expressible exactly and is declared below as a constraints entry of type "unique". OMISSIONS. No `id`, `created_at` or `updated_at` field is declared: the record subsystem owns record identity and the event store owns the timeline. CONSTRAINT NOT EXPRESSIBLE HERE: the source's CHECK (sort_order >= 0) is a single-column range check with no entity-definition expression; it is recorded in README-constraints.md in this directory, along with the fact that relocating it loses database-level enforcement.
